is.notes: Pre-2018 presentation: income statement shows only 'Total revenues' (freight & delivery revenues included). is.delivery_rev = 'Freight and delivery revenues' and is.net_sales = 'Total revenues excluding freight and delivery revenues' from the release's non-GAAP gross-margin reconciliation (published figures, not computed). No noncontrolling interest (nci = 0). dps = cash dividends per share as shown in the release/10-Q statement of earnings. In the Q4-16 release restructuring charges are folded into 'Other operating income (expense), net' for Q4/FY presentation.

ngaap.notes: EBITDA (Vulcan definition) excludes discontinued operations: the Net earnings->EBITDA reconciliation adds back income tax (continuing ops), interest expense, net, and '(Earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax' (captured in extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback), then DDA&A. Hence the schema check ni_vulcan + tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub only holds after adding ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback; adj_items.disc_ops is null (not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). ebitda_bridge_lines = EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA lines (zero lines kept as published). FY2016 from Q4-16 release twelve-month columns. Bridge 'Diluted EPS' = diluted EPS from continuing operations. FY2016 Adjusted Diluted EPS was later re-presented as $3.03 in the Q4-17 release (ASU 2016-09 excess tax benefits no longer adjusted; only $(0.08) FTC item) — original $2.86 kept here.
